questions.question: What does LIFO stand for in data structures?
questions.explanation: LIFO means the most recently added element is the first one to be removed.

questions.question: Which operation adds an element to the top of a stack?
questions.explanation: Push inserts an element onto the top of the stack.

questions.question: What happens when you perform a Pop operation on an empty stack?
questions.explanation: Attempting to remove an element from an empty stack causes a Stack Underflow error.

questions.question: Give a common real-world analogy for a stack data structure.
questions.correct_answer: A pile of plates or a stack of books
questions.explanation: A pile of plates is a classic example: you add new plates to the top and remove plates from the top.

questions.question: Which operation inspects the top item of the stack without removing it?
questions.explanation: Peek allows inspecting the element at the top of the stack without modifying the stack.
